list.name: prompt
list.label: Prompt
list.query: SELECT task_id || ' · ' || version || ' · ' || added || latest AS __text, task_id || '|' || version AS __value FROM (SELECT prompt_versions.task_id AS task_id, prompt_versions.version AS version, replace(substr(prompt_versions.added_at, 1, 16), 'T', ' ') AS added, CASE WHEN prompt_versions.version = tasks.prompt_version THEN ' · latest' ELSE '' END AS latest, prompt_versions.added_at AS added_at FROM prompt_versions LEFT JOIN tasks ON tasks.task_id = prompt_versions.task_id WHERE prompt_versions.kind = 'prompt' AND prompt_versions.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND ('*' IN (${prompt_added:singlequote}) OR substr(prompt_versions.added_at, 1, 10) IN (${prompt_added:singlequote})) UNION ALL SELECT runs.task_id, 'unknown', 'unknown', '', NULL FROM runs WHERE runs.prompt_version IS NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND '*' IN (${prompt_added:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id) ORDER BY added_at DESC
list.definition: SELECT task_id || ' · ' || version || ' · ' || added || latest AS __text, task_id || '|' || version AS __value FROM (SELECT prompt_versions.task_id AS task_id, prompt_versions.version AS version, replace(substr(prompt_versions.added_at, 1, 16), 'T', ' ') AS added, CASE WHEN prompt_versions.version = tasks.prompt_version THEN ' · latest' ELSE '' END AS latest, prompt_versions.added_at AS added_at FROM prompt_versions LEFT JOIN tasks ON tasks.task_id = prompt_versions.task_id WHERE prompt_versions.kind = 'prompt' AND prompt_versions.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND ('*' IN (${prompt_added:singlequote}) OR substr(prompt_versions.added_at, 1, 10) IN (${prompt_added:singlequote})) UNION ALL SELECT runs.task_id, 'unknown', 'unknown', '', NULL FROM runs WHERE runs.prompt_version IS NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND '*' IN (${prompt_added:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id) ORDER BY added_at DESC

list.name: judge
list.label: Judge prompt
list.query: SELECT task_id || ' · ' || version || ' · ' || added || latest AS __text, task_id || '|' || version AS __value FROM (SELECT prompt_versions.task_id AS task_id, prompt_versions.version AS version, replace(substr(prompt_versions.added_at, 1, 16), 'T', ' ') AS added, CASE WHEN prompt_versions.version = tasks.judge_prompt_version THEN ' · latest' ELSE '' END AS latest, prompt_versions.added_at AS added_at FROM prompt_versions LEFT JOIN tasks ON tasks.task_id = prompt_versions.task_id WHERE prompt_versions.kind = 'judge' AND prompt_versions.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND ('*' IN (${judge_added:singlequote}) OR substr(prompt_versions.added_at, 1, 10) IN (${judge_added:singlequote})) UNION ALL SELECT runs.task_id, 'unknown', 'unknown', '', NULL FROM runs WHERE runs.judge_prompt_version IS NULL AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND '*' IN (${judge_added:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id) ORDER BY added_at DESC

list.name: decision
list.label: Judge decision
list.query: SELECT decision FROM (SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(judge_runs.decision, 'unjudged') AS decision FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})) ORDER BY CASE decision WHEN 'failed' THEN 1 WHEN 'partially-failed' THEN 2 WHEN 'partially-pass' THEN 3 WHEN 'pass' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
list.definition: SELECT decision FROM (SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(judge_runs.decision, 'unjudged') AS decision FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote})) ORDER BY CASE decision WHEN 'failed' THEN 1 WHEN 'partially-failed' THEN 2 WHEN 'partially-pass' THEN 3 WHEN 'pass' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT runs.run_id FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND coalesce(judge_runs.decision, 'unjudged') IN (${decision:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC

panels.title: Tokens per run by config
panels.description: Average tokens in one run, split by type. The label shows how many runs each bar averages. Lower is better.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.config_id || ' (' || count(*) || ' runs)' AS config, avg(runs.input_tokens) AS "fresh input", avg(runs.cache_creation_tokens) AS "cache write", avg(runs.cache_read_tokens) AS "cache read", avg(runs.output_tokens) AS output FROM runs WHERE runs.status IN ('done', 'crashed') AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.config_id ORDER BY avg(runs.total_tokens)
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.config_id || ' (' || count(*) || ' runs)' AS config, avg(runs.input_tokens) AS "fresh input", avg(runs.cache_creation_tokens) AS "cache write", avg(runs.cache_read_tokens) AS "cache read", avg(runs.output_tokens) AS output FROM runs WHERE runs.status IN ('done', 'crashed') AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.config_id ORDER BY avg(runs.total_tokens)

panels.title: Tokens vs ${baseline} (%)
panels.description: Average tokens per run relative to the baseline, compared task by task with every task weighted equally, so a config that ran more of the big tasks isn't penalised. Below zero uses fewer tokens.

targets.queryText: WITH per_task AS (SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, avg(judge_runs.success) AS pass, avg(runs.cost_usd) AS cost, avg(runs.total_tokens) AS tokens, avg(runs.duration_ms) AS duration FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.status IN ('done', 'crashed') AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND (runs.config_id = ${baseline:singlequote} OR (runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}))) GROUP BY runs.task_id, runs.config_id) SELECT config.config_id AS config, round(100.0 * avg(config.tokens / base.tokens - 1), 1) AS "token change" FROM per_task AS config JOIN per_task AS base ON base.task_id = config.task_id AND base.config_id = ${baseline:singlequote} WHERE config.config_id != ${baseline:singlequote} GROUP BY config.config_id ORDER BY 2 DESC
targets.rawQueryText: WITH per_task AS (SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, avg(judge_runs.success) AS pass, avg(runs.cost_usd) AS cost, avg(runs.total_tokens) AS tokens, avg(runs.duration_ms) AS duration FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.status IN ('done', 'crashed') AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND (runs.config_id = ${baseline:singlequote} OR (runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}))) GROUP BY runs.task_id, runs.config_id) SELECT config.config_id AS config, round(100.0 * avg(config.tokens / base.tokens - 1), 1) AS "token change" FROM per_task AS config JOIN per_task AS base ON base.task_id = config.task_id AND base.config_id = ${baseline:singlequote} WHERE config.config_id != ${baseline:singlequote} GROUP BY config.config_id ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: All tokens spent divided by the number of passing runs, so failed runs count against a config. Lower is better; empty means no run passed.

panels.title: Tool calls per run by kind
panels.description: Average number of tool calls in one run, split by kind. Shows whether an MCP config actually uses its MCP tools and what it replaces.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.config_id AS config, round(1.0 * count(CASE WHEN calls.category = 'read & search' THEN 1 END) / count(DISTINCT runs.run_id), 1) AS "read & search", round(1.0 * count(CASE WHEN calls.category = 'edit' THEN 1 END) / count(DISTINCT runs.run_id), 1) AS "edit", round(1.0 * count(CASE WHEN calls.category = 'shell' THEN 1 END) / count(DISTINCT runs.run_id), 1) AS "shell", round(1.0 * count(CASE WHEN calls.category = 'MCP' THEN 1 END) / count(DISTINCT runs.run_id), 1) AS "MCP", round(1.0 * count(CASE WHEN calls.category = 'subagent' THEN 1 END) / count(DISTINCT runs.run_id), 1) AS "subagent", round(1.0 * count(CASE WHEN calls.category = 'other' THEN 1 END) / count(DISTINCT runs.run_id), 1) AS "other" FROM runs LEFT JOIN (SELECT run_id, tool_use_id, CASE WHEN substr(tool, 1, 5) = 'mcp__' THEN 'MCP' WHEN tool IN ('Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'LS', 'NotebookRead') THEN 'read & search' WHEN tool IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit') THEN 'edit' WHEN tool = 'Bash' THEN 'shell' WHEN tool IN ('Task', 'Agent') THEN 'subagent' ELSE 'other' END AS category FROM tool_calls WHERE phase = 'pre' GROUP BY tool_use_id) AS calls ON calls.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.status IN ('done', 'crashed') AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.config_id ORDER BY runs.config_id

panels.title: Blocked runs
panels.description: Runs where the judge found that a missing, denied, or failing tool or program stopped the agent.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.config_id, count(CASE json_extract(blocker.value, '$.kind') WHEN 'missing-tool' THEN 1 END) AS "missing tool", count(CASE json_extract(blocker.value, '$.kind') WHEN 'denied' THEN 1 END) AS denied, count(CASE json_extract(blocker.value, '$.kind') WHEN 'exec-failed' THEN 1 END) AS "exec failed", count(CASE WHEN blocker.value IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS unspecified FROM judge_runs JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = judge_runs.run_id LEFT JOIN json_each(judge_runs.blockers) AS blocker WHERE judge_runs.blocked = 1 AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.config_id ORDER BY runs.config_id
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.config_id, count(CASE json_extract(blocker.value, '$.kind') WHEN 'missing-tool' THEN 1 END) AS "missing tool", count(CASE json_extract(blocker.value, '$.kind') WHEN 'denied' THEN 1 END) AS denied, count(CASE json_extract(blocker.value, '$.kind') WHEN 'exec-failed' THEN 1 END) AS "exec failed", count(CASE WHEN blocker.value IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS unspecified FROM judge_runs JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = judge_runs.run_id LEFT JOIN json_each(judge_runs.blockers) AS blocker WHERE judge_runs.blocked = 1 AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.config_id ORDER BY runs.config_id

panels.title: Blockers (newest first)

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.started_at, runs.task_id, runs.config_id, judge_runs.decision, json_extract(blocker.value, '$.kind') AS kind, json_extract(blocker.value, '$.tool') AS tool, COALESCE(json_extract(blocker.value, '$.detail'), judge_runs.reason) AS "what happened", runs.run_id FROM judge_runs JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = judge_runs.run_id LEFT JOIN json_each(judge_runs.blockers) AS blocker WHERE judge_runs.blocked = 1 AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC, blocker.key LIMIT 200

panels.title: Prompt versions
panels.description: One row per task and the prompt versions that run used. prompt and judge_prompt are the first 8 hex chars of the sha256 of the prompt text. prompt_added and judge_added are when that hash was first seen. current marks the hash on the task row, which is the latest one loaded. unknown is a run from before versions were recorded. Prompt added and Judge added filter by that day. Prompt and Judge prompt filter by the hash.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') AS prompt, min(prompt_added.added_at) AS prompt_added, coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') AS judge_prompt, min(judge_added.added_at) AS judge_added, CASE WHEN runs.prompt_version = tasks.prompt_version AND runs.judge_prompt_version = tasks.judge_prompt_version THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS current, count(*) AS runs, count(judge_runs.decision) AS judged, coalesce(sum(judge_runs.success), 0) AS passed, round(100.0 * avg(judge_runs.success)) AS pass_rate, avg(runs.cost_usd) AS avg_cost, round(avg(runs.duration_ms) / 1000.0) AS avg_seconds, min(runs.started_at) AS first_run, max(runs.started_at) AS last_run FROM runs LEFT JOIN tasks ON tasks.task_id = runs.task_id LEFT JOIN prompt_versions AS prompt_added ON prompt_added.task_id = runs.task_id AND prompt_added.kind = 'prompt' AND prompt_added.version = runs.prompt_version LEFT JOIN prompt_versions AS judge_added ON judge_added.task_id = runs.task_id AND judge_added.kind = 'judge' AND judge_added.version = runs.judge_prompt_version LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id, runs.prompt_version, runs.judge_prompt_version ORDER BY runs.task_id, first_run DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') AS prompt, min(prompt_added.added_at) AS prompt_added, coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') AS judge_prompt, min(judge_added.added_at) AS judge_added, CASE WHEN runs.prompt_version = tasks.prompt_version AND runs.judge_prompt_version = tasks.judge_prompt_version THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS current, count(*) AS runs, count(judge_runs.decision) AS judged, coalesce(sum(judge_runs.success), 0) AS passed, round(100.0 * avg(judge_runs.success)) AS pass_rate, avg(runs.cost_usd) AS avg_cost, round(avg(runs.duration_ms) / 1000.0) AS avg_seconds, min(runs.started_at) AS first_run, max(runs.started_at) AS last_run FROM runs LEFT JOIN tasks ON tasks.task_id = runs.task_id LEFT JOIN prompt_versions AS prompt_added ON prompt_added.task_id = runs.task_id AND prompt_added.kind = 'prompt' AND prompt_added.version = runs.prompt_version LEFT JOIN prompt_versions AS judge_added ON judge_added.task_id = runs.task_id AND judge_added.kind = 'judge' AND judge_added.version = runs.judge_prompt_version LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id, runs.prompt_version, runs.judge_prompt_version ORDER BY runs.task_id, first_run DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.prompt_version AS prompt, runs.judge_prompt_version AS judge_prompt, (SELECT group_concat(name || ' ×' || calls, ', ') FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN tool = 'Bash' AND coalesce(program, '') != '' THEN program ELSE tool END AS name, count(DISTINCT tool_use_id) AS calls FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_calls.run_id = runs.run_id AND phase = 'pre' GROUP BY name ORDER BY calls DESC, name)) AS tools, judge_runs.decision, judge_runs.success, judge_runs.blocked, substr(judge_runs.reason, 1, 160) AS judge, judge_runs.cost_usd AS judge_cost, judge_runs.num_turns AS judge_turns, round(judge_runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS judge_seconds, runs.input_tokens AS fresh, runs.cache_creation_tokens AS cache_write, runs.cache_read_tokens AS cache_read, runs.output_tokens AS output, runs.total_tokens AS tokens, runs.cost_usd, runs.num_turns AS turns, runs.status, COALESCE(json_array_length(runs.changed_files), 0) AS files, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", round(runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS seconds, runs.model, runs.started_at, runs.run_id, runs.branch, runs.permission_denials AS denials FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC LIMIT 100
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.prompt_version AS prompt, runs.judge_prompt_version AS judge_prompt, (SELECT group_concat(name || ' ×' || calls, ', ') FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN tool = 'Bash' AND coalesce(program, '') != '' THEN program ELSE tool END AS name, count(DISTINCT tool_use_id) AS calls FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_calls.run_id = runs.run_id AND phase = 'pre' GROUP BY name ORDER BY calls DESC, name)) AS tools, judge_runs.decision, judge_runs.success, judge_runs.blocked, substr(judge_runs.reason, 1, 160) AS judge, judge_runs.cost_usd AS judge_cost, judge_runs.num_turns AS judge_turns, round(judge_runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS judge_seconds, runs.input_tokens AS fresh, runs.cache_creation_tokens AS cache_write, runs.cache_read_tokens AS cache_read, runs.output_tokens AS output, runs.total_tokens AS tokens, runs.cost_usd, runs.num_turns AS turns, runs.status, COALESCE(json_array_length(runs.changed_files), 0) AS files, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", round(runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS seconds, runs.model, runs.started_at, runs.run_id, runs.branch, runs.permission_denials AS denials FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Tools by run
panels.description: For Bash, each row is the program the script actually ran (git, grep, head). calls counts distinct invocations. blocked means the call has no post-hook result, so it was denied or never finished.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.run_id, counts.name AS tool, counts.calls, counts.blocked, counts.errors FROM runs JOIN (SELECT pre.run_id, CASE WHEN pre.tool = 'Bash' AND coalesce(pre.program, '') != '' THEN pre.program ELSE pre.tool END AS name, count(DISTINCT pre.tool_use_id) AS calls, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN post.id IS NULL THEN pre.tool_use_id END) AS blocked, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN post.is_error = 1 THEN pre.tool_use_id END) AS errors FROM tool_calls pre LEFT JOIN tool_calls post ON post.tool_use_id = pre.tool_use_id AND post.phase = 'post' WHERE pre.phase = 'pre' GROUP BY pre.run_id, name) AS counts ON counts.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC, counts.calls DESC LIMIT 500
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.run_id, counts.name AS tool, counts.calls, counts.blocked, counts.errors FROM runs JOIN (SELECT pre.run_id, CASE WHEN pre.tool = 'Bash' AND coalesce(pre.program, '') != '' THEN pre.program ELSE pre.tool END AS name, count(DISTINCT pre.tool_use_id) AS calls, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN post.id IS NULL THEN pre.tool_use_id END) AS blocked, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN post.is_error = 1 THEN pre.tool_use_id END) AS errors FROM tool_calls pre LEFT JOIN tool_calls post ON post.tool_use_id = pre.tool_use_id AND post.phase = 'post' WHERE pre.phase = 'pre' GROUP BY pre.run_id, name) AS counts ON counts.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC, counts.calls DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Bash commands
panels.description: One row per Bash invocation. programs are the executables that script runs, from the same parse the baseline guard uses. A pipe inside quotes stays part of the command.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.run_id, replace(group_concat(DISTINCT pre.program), ',', ', ') AS programs, substr(min(pre.command), 1, 200) AS command, CASE WHEN max(post.id) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS blocked, max(coalesce(post.is_error, 0)) AS is_error FROM tool_calls pre JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = pre.run_id LEFT JOIN tool_calls post ON post.tool_use_id = pre.tool_use_id AND post.phase = 'post' WHERE pre.phase = 'pre' AND pre.tool = 'Bash' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY pre.tool_use_id ORDER BY max(pre.id) DESC LIMIT 200
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.run_id, replace(group_concat(DISTINCT pre.program), ',', ', ') AS programs, substr(min(pre.command), 1, 200) AS command, CASE WHEN max(post.id) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS blocked, max(coalesce(post.is_error, 0)) AS is_error FROM tool_calls pre JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = pre.run_id LEFT JOIN tool_calls post ON post.tool_use_id = pre.tool_use_id AND post.phase = 'post' WHERE pre.phase = 'pre' AND pre.tool = 'Bash' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY pre.tool_use_id ORDER BY max(pre.id) DESC LIMIT 200

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.branch, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", json_extract(file.value, '$.status') AS status, json_extract(file.value, '$.path') AS path, json_extract(file.value, '$.previousPath') AS previous_path, runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.started_at FROM runs, json_each(runs.changed_files) AS file WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND runs.task_id || '|' || coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC, path LIMIT 500

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT tool_calls.ts, tool_calls.run_id, tool, program, CASE WHEN tool IN ('Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'LS', 'WebFetch', 'WebSearch', 'NotebookRead') THEN 'read' WHEN tool IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit') THEN 'write' WHEN tool = 'Bash' THEN 'shell' ELSE 'other' END AS action, substr(command, 1, 160) AS command, is_error FROM tool_calls JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE phase = 'pre' AND task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND task_id || '|' || coalesce(prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${prompt:singlequote}) AND task_id || '|' || coalesce(judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') IN (${judge:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY tool_calls.id DESC LIMIT 100
